info.title: ProA API
info.description: ProA 2.0: a headless store for process landscapes. Problems are RFC 9457 `application/problem+json`.

agentToken.description: Agent token (`proa_at_…`). In local mode the web UI and the CLI act as the owner through the session cookie from `POST /api/v1/session` instead.

Candidate.description: A candidate relation for agents to judge.

Ref.description: Reference to a BPMN element: `<model_key>#<element_id>`, or `<model_key>#<process_id>` for a process.

CandidateBasis.description: Why a pair of endpoints is a candidate.

CandidateSignals.description: Similarity signals behind a candidate score.

DerivedRelation.description: A relation computed by code (rules or baseline).

ProjectFacts.description: Head facts of all of a project's models.

ModelKey.description: Immutable model key: lowercase slug segments separated by `/`.

ProcessInfo.description: A BPMN process defined in a model.

ElementId.description: BPMN element or process id (XML NCName).

Fact.description: A fact extracted from one BPMN model revision.

FactKind.description: Kind of a fact extracted from a BPMN model.

FactScope.description: Scope of the element within its process.

EventDef.description: Event definition of an event; `none` for a plain event.

FactAttrs.description: Kind-specific attributes of a fact (open object).

MessageFlowInfo.description: A message flow within one collaboration file.

CreateSessionBody.description: Request body to open a local-mode owner session.

InteractiveClient.description: Interactive client of a human user.

CreateProjectBody.description: Request body to create a project.

Model.description: A BPMN model (one file) with a stable key.

PutModelResult.description: Result of uploading one BPMN file.

Revision.description: An immutable revision of a model.

ImportResult.description: Outcome per file of an import.

ImportFileOutcome.description: Outcome of one file of an import.

files.description: BPMN files; each part’s filename is its path below the import root.

Landscape.description: The current process landscape of a project.

LandscapeModel.description: A model as part of the landscape.

RelationType.description: Type of a relation between two processes.

EndpointState.description: State of the relation endpoints in the head revisions.

Finding.description: A deterministic finding about the landscape.

FindingList.description: Deterministic findings of the project head.

AgentToken.description: An API key for one project, used by MCP clients and scripts.

CreatedAgentToken.description: A new agent token including its secret (shown once).

CreateAgentTokenBody.description: Request body to create an agent token.

post.summary: Local mode: open an owner session (HttpOnly cookie) for the web UI or the CLI
post.description: Local mode only (`PROA_AUTH=local`). Sets the `proa_session` cookie (HttpOnly, SameSite=Strict); requests carrying it act as the single owner on an interactive client. The server accepts it only from localhost (Host and Origin checks).

delete.summary: Local mode: end the owner session (clears the cookie)

get.summary: Projects the caller is a member of

post.summary: Create a project; the caller becomes its owner

get.summary: Models of a project, optionally filtered by pipeline stage

delete.summary: Delete a model; partner relations become `missing`

put.summary: Upload raw BPMN: 201 new model, 200 new revision or unchanged

parameters.description: Immutable model key: lowercase slug segments separated by `/`.
parameters.name: key

200.description: New revision, or `unchanged` for identical content

get.summary: Revisions of a model, newest first
The verbatim BPMN bytes of a revision

post.summary: Import up to 50 BPMN files; the model key is the slugified path

get.summary: The project head: models, processes, relations, findings (ETag `"s<seq>"`)
Relations, filtered by type, status, tier or model

parameters.description: Type of a relation between two processes.
parameters.name: type

parameters.description: Immutable model key: lowercase slug segments separated by `/`.
parameters.name: modelKey

get.summary: Deterministic findings of the project head

post.summary: Create an agent token; the secret is shown once (owner, interactive client)

201.description: The new token with its secret

delete.summary: Revoke an agent token (owner, interactive client)
